entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-31
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Unexpected indirect load instruction is emitted for ref assignment to a discard #84724
    18.11
  • MSBuildWorkspace.TryApplyChanges of a file-based app materializes the virtual project to disk #84721
    18.11

Closed

  • Using `[AllowNull]` with field keyword should synthesize a nullable backing field when field is assigned a possibly null value #84720
  • VB.NET Local variable is corrupted after binary If(,) operator with Await in second operand #84517
    18.10
  • Unexpected nullable warning when using field keyword with null coalescing operator #84719
  • CS8604 showing regardless of assert on the same property. #84718
  • safe keyword on LibraryImport #84555
    .NET 11

PullRequests

Created

  • Remove dotnet-format tool from dotnet-tools.json #84728
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3036300 #84727
  • Improves tracking of pending solution updates #84726
    Interactive-EnC, VSCode
  • Add compiler telemetry #84725
    Area-Compilers
  • Disallow applying updates to FBA MSBuildWorkspace #84722
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Better handling for Razor on type formatting edits around the cursor #84717
    Area-Razor

Merged

  • [release/insiders] Point insiders to VS insiders #84730
  • Change insertionCreateDraftPR to false after VS snap #84729
  • Clone the IR tree so we don't have to re-lower from syntax. #84715
    Area-Razor
  • Fix Razor code block close brace indentation #84716
    Area-Razor
  • Generate Documentation - incorrect buffer bug #84709
  • VB: Fix state tracking in AbstractFlowPass.VisitBinaryConditionalExpression #84705
    Area-Compilers
  • Unions: enforce the same order of processing for base interfaces of a member provider interface source vs. metadata. #84664
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Add ITypeSymbol.UnionCaseTypes property #84707
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Unions
  • Unsafe evolution: fixup conflicting merges #84723
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Unsafe evolution: add ISymbol public API #84674
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Unsafe evolution: relax `safe` modifier placement restrictions #84602
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution

Updated

  • More fixes for Razor multiline attribute formatting #84656
    Area-Razor
  • Handle textDocument/didChange notifications that don't pass across the range #84714
    VSCode
  • Optimize file-based app loading with ProjectFileInfo cache #83470
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Add tests in CI that our NuGet packages can reliabily install #84711
  • Migrate Csc to multithreaded MSBuild execution #84701
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Unsafe evolution: symbol display #84706
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Migrate GenerateMSBuildEditorConfig task to multithreaded mode #84419
    Community
  • Migrate CopyRefAssembly to multithreaded execution model #84420
    Community
  • Migrate MapSourceRoots task to multithreaded mode #84421
    Community
  • Unsafe evolution: allow await in unsafe context #84616
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Nullable annotate Symbol.ContainingType #84536
    Area-Compilers
  • Share metadata between lsp server instances in daemon mode #84713
    VSCode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #84544
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #83901
    Area-Infrastructure, Needs API Review
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #84654
  • Fix #84293: Make args parameter non-nullable in top-level statements #84506
    Area-Compilers, Community
